query.description: Literal terms separated by spaces; all must match. Empty browses recent messages.
query.title: Query

scope.description: project searches the current folder, or unbound chats when no folder is open. all searches all conversations.
scope.title: Scope

session_id.description: Search only this conversation; overrides scope. 'current' selects this conversation.
session_id.title: Session Id

before_message_id.description: Use next_before_message_id from the previous result to continue with the same query and scope.
before_message_id.title: Before Message Id
